_comment: PCB-0017-A stereo-class-d-amp P3 part-sourcer output (SPEC P3, 6.1). Build qty 5, JLC PCBA top side. Every LCSC code re-verified live against parts_search.py on 2026-09-27, not carried unchecked from research/*.json. Two corrections against the P2 research shortlist, both real dielectric mismatches against architecture/sheets.md's own value table: (1) C1-C4 spec'd X7R but research picked CL21A225KBQNNNE which is X5R - replaced with a genuine X7R part; (2) C7/C8 spec'd C0G/NP0 but research picked CL10B102KB8NNNC which is X7R - replaced with a genuine NP0 part. C11/C12 (10uF, sheets.md says X7R) keeps the orchestrator's explicit state.json-decided MPN CL21A106KAYNNNE, which is X5R at JLC - flagged in OPEN rather than overridden, since that MPN was a named P1 decision, not a research guess. One entry per distinct part; qty_per_board and refs carried for the librarian/schematic phases, `stock` and `price` are the live parts_search values, `price` is qty-1 unit price (price_breaks carried where present).

parts.value: TPA3118D2DAPR - stereo BTL class-D amp, HTSSOP-32-EP-6.1mm, PowerPAD DOWN

alternates.note: Automotive AEC-Q100 grade of the same part, same HTSSOP-32-EP-6.1mm DAP pad-down package (verified live - description confirms the EP/pad-down footprint match, not the pad-up DAD family). Genuine pin- and footprint-compatible swap, no layout change needed. Stock 585 (117x this board's 5-unit build qty) at $2.26@1, ~2.1x TPA3118D2DAPR's price - a real alternate, not a cost-equal one.

parts.role: U1, the whole amplifier. Live-reconfirmed C46497: stock 38903 (7781x build qty), unchanged from P1's amp-ic research. DAP=pad-down is the recorded (state.json P1) deviation from the brief's TPA3116D2, which exists at JLC only as DAD=pad-up (TPA3116D2DADR C50144, TPA3116D2DAD C2865736 - both checked, both rejected, package confirmed pad-up in both live descriptions) and would need a top clip heatsink the brief's SMD-only/thermal-copper design does not build. Single-source risk on the pad-down variant itself is real (only one non-automotive DAP listing exists at JLC) but is not unmitigated: the automotive-grade sibling above is a true alternate at 117x stock margin.

parts.value: 10uH, Isat 5.5A, Irms 4A, DCR 66mOhm, shielded power inductor

alternates.note: Chilisin near-identical: Isat 5.5A, Irms 4A, DCR 68mOhm, same 7.3x6.6mm SMD footprint. Stock 9210 (115x this board's 80-unit build qty), $0.1326@1. Straight footprint/electrical swap.

parts.role: L1-L4, one per BTL leg. Live-reconfirmed C207842: stock 16183 (202x the 80-unit build qty), unchanged from P1/P2. Isat 5.5A clears the 4.0A spec floor (constraints.json B4 isat_min_a) with margin against the 7.5A OC trip's 1uH-remaining rule; DCR 66mOhm is within the <=70mOhm sheets.md ceiling. Not Basic (no Basic part exists at this Isat/size class); size is the board's own driver per blocks.md, not a P3 choice.

alternates.note: 35V polymer D6.3xL7, ESR 80mOhm, ripple 1.5A@100kHz; fallback only (higher ESR).

parts.role: C13, bulk polymer cap at PVCC 31/32 (nearest J1). Uprated 25V->35V after schematic review W1: the ~26V hot-plug ring exceeded the 25V part. Same family as the earlier pick (jieerrui MA), same D6.3 land.

C14, second bulk cap at PVCC 15/16. Replaced RVT (no stated ESR) after schematic review W2 with a part that states ESR and 100kHz ripple. Not relied on to damp the hot-plug ring (review W1: parallel polymer dominates); D1 TVS clamps that instead.

C1-C4, AC-coupling into LINP/LINN/RINP/RINN. Cut 2.2uF->1uF after schematic review W3: tau 60k*1uF=60ms, so an unplugged-input start-up offset decays below the DC-detect threshold in ~150ms, well inside the 420ms window. HPF corner ~2.7Hz at Zi 60k (4.2Hz at Zi -20%+cap -10%). Basic part.

alternates.note: Samwha, same 1uF/25V/X7R/0603, cheaper ($0.0132@1), stock 224412 (44882x build qty).

parts.role: C5, GVDD decoupling (datasheet-mandated, TI SLOS708G 6.5). CORRECTED from the P2 research pick (CL10A105KB8NNNC, C15849): that part is X5R/50V, but sheets.md's own value table specifies X7R 25V 0603 for C5. Live-verified C106858 is genuinely X7R at the exact 25V rating; stock 321218 (64243x the 5-unit build qty).

C6 (AVCC, pin 17) + C9/C10 (100nF tier at each PVCC pair, sheets.md pin table 18/19 and 31/32). Basic passive, huge stock (17123992x build qty of 15) - no alternate needed for a part this deep in stock. Live-reconfirmed X7R/50V matches sheets.md exactly.

alternates.note: Same 1nF/50V/NP0/0603, tighter +/-1% tolerance vs the primary's +/-5%. Stock 507379 (50738x build qty), $0.0165@1.

parts.role: C7/C8, the switching-edge loop cap at each PVCC pair (sheets.md pin table 18/19, 31/32; DS 8.2.2.4). CORRECTED from the P2 research pick (CL10B102KB8NNNC, C1588): that part's own JLC description is X7R, not C0G/NP0 as sheets.md's value table specifies for this position (a real dielectric-stability difference at the switching-edge node, not a cosmetic one). Live-verified C106246 is genuinely NP0; no Basic NP0 1nF 0603 part was found at JLC (all C0G/NP0 1nF 0603 hits came back Extended), so this stays Extended - stock 2196632 (109831x the 10-unit build qty) makes that a non-issue.

C11/C12, 10uF tier at each PVCC pair (sheets.md pin table; state.json P1 decision names this exact MPN, 'Basic 0805, not 1206'). Live-reconfirmed C15850: stock 5536272 (276813x build qty of 20), still Basic. NOTE (see OPEN): this MPN is X5R, while sheets.md's own value table lists X7R for C11/C12 - kept as-is because the orchestrator named this MPN explicitly as a P1 decision, not because P3 re-derived it; flagged for H1/P1 to reconcile the dielectric note against the named part.

C15-C18, one bootstrap cap per BSxx/OUTxx pin pair, each loop local (sheets.md pin table). Basic, live-reconfirmed X7R/50V matches spec exactly. Stock 671741 (33587x the 20-unit build qty) - no alternate needed.

alternates.note: CCTC, same 680nF/50V/X7R/0805, cheapest of the group ($0.0174@1) but thinner stock (10944, still 547x build qty).

parts.role: C19-C22, the LC output filter cap, f0=61kHz with the 10uH inductor (blocks.md B4). Live-reconfirmed C107133: stock 15895 (795x the 20-unit build qty) - comfortably above the 5x floor despite being Extended.

C23-C26, damping-branch cap in series with R4-R7 (Zobel-style, sheets.md B4). 0402 is allowed here even though the board is JLC PCBA (not hand-solder) - rule 3's 0402 floor is a hand-solder concern, not a PCBA one. Basic, stock 4452622 (222631x build qty) - no alternate needed.

R1, GAIN/SLV to GND - sets 20dB master mode, latched at power-up (sheets.md pin 8). Picked via parts_search --pick basic-passive (not in the P2 research shortlist, which covered ICs/caps/inductor/one damping resistor value only). Basic, stock 1191631 (238326x build qty) - no alternate needed.

R2 (SDZ+FAULTZ pull-up to +12V, self-clearing fault) and R3 (MUTE pull-down to GND, outputs enabled) - sheets.md pins 2/3 and 12. Picked via parts_search --pick basic-passive. Basic, stock 22826205 (2282620x build qty) - no alternate needed.

R4-R7, Zobel damping branch across each speaker net (blocks.md B4). No Basic 3.3ohm exists at any package per P2 research; live-reconfirmed 100mW rating exactly meets sheets.md's '>=100mW' floor (no margin above it - worth a second look at P4/P8 if the damping branch's dissipation estimate tightens). Stock 159062 (7953x the 20-unit build qty).

parts.package: 2x SMD pad, approx 3.0x6.0mm each, >=1.5mm apart, no connector body
parts.role: J1, 12V power in for 18-20AWG leads (blocks.md B1, requirements.md Q3/Q1 default). No LCSC part exists for a bare copper pad and none is invented here - footprint-only, not orderable. Carries 4A design current per constraints.json; pad sizing/spoke count is P6's job.

parts.value: Bare SMD wire-pad trio, R / GND / L stereo line input
parts.role: J2, stereo line-level input (blocks.md B2). Footprint-only, no orderable part.

parts.value: Bare SMD wire-pad pair, left speaker +/- (BTL, neither terminal is ground)
parts.role: J3, left speaker output, 3A design current (blocks.md B4/interfaces table). Footprint-only, no orderable part. Silkscreen must flag BTL per requirements.md section 8.

parts.value: Bare SMD wire-pad pair, right speaker +/- (BTL, neither terminal is ground)
parts.role: J4, right speaker output, 3A design current. Footprint-only, no orderable part. Silkscreen must flag BTL per requirements.md section 8.

parts.value: Bare SMD test-point pad, GND probe
parts.role: TP1, GND probe pad on the quiet input corner (constraints.json placement.edges). Footprint-only, no orderable part.
D1, TVS across J1 +12V/GND. Added after schematic review W1: clamps the hot-plug ring (~26V) below the TPA3118 30V PVCC abs max. Vwm 15V clears a 12V +10% adapter.
